summary: Adds weather/diagnostics.py: a reusable, side-effect-free Weather readiness authority (P1 1.15/2.4 Pass B). Extracts persona/voice validation from WeatherConfigForm into weather/persona_readiness.py, shared by both. Adds a read-only weather_diagnostics command and moves the Admin storage subpage onto the same authority instead of a hardcoded file list. Exposes the existing 6h forecast-cache warning as evidence only. No schema change, no network/TTS/subprocess calls, no on-air behavior change.
